text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make my way into the cafeteria, where
I notice a
small crowd huddled around a
table scattered
with coins.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Go all in, I dare ya. Let's raise the stakes
and
make things more excitin'.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Eek! Run away!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, what a shame. And after I went to
all this
trouble to set this up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah, not exactly. Just a lil' make-believe
using
chocolate coins as chips.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Casual games over candy aren't against
the rules
now, are they?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know what ya thought. ...Here,
pull up a
seat.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna make it up to me, humor
me with a
round of poker. Five-card
draw.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her gaze fiercely fixed upon me, I
agree to a
match with Nakayama Festa,
and so the game
begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shuffle.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, terrible poker face ya got there. I
take it
you've got a good starting hand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But does it top mine? Here, lemme give
ya a
sneak peek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Nakayama Festa starts
revealing her
cards without a shred of
hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Look here. I've got a three, four, five,
and a six.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If my last card's a seven, that's a straight.
Not too
shabby. What're you workin'
with over there?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look down at my three of a kind. If
she's telling
the truth, she has a better
hand than I do.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, what a killjoy. So you're the type to
lie in
wait for the right opportunity, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But I have to admit, you did make the
right call
this round.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She reveals her last card as she says
this—a seven
of hearts. I nearly fell for
her ruse!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ya dodged a bullet there. But are ya
really
content just playin' it safe? Play
like you mean it.
I want somethin'
high-stakes and down to the
wire.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Puttin' it all on the line and goin' all in,
eh? Little
better than throwin' yourself
to the wolves...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Still, true victory can only be obtained
by those
willing to seize it right outta
the maw of death.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she shows me her last
card—a four of
clubs. My gamble paid
off!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Guess this was worthwhile, after all.
To think
I'd find someone here cut from
the same cloth as
me.
